query: I was walking my golden retriever this morning and he ended up rolling in a patch of wild clover, so I had to stop by the pet store on my way home to pick up extra dog shampoo. When I was checking out, the cashier was telling me about this new local bakery that makes the most amazing matcha croissants, I even jotted down the address so I can go try them this weekend. Oh right, I also wanted to ask for help with my phone: my SMS permissions aren't working properly right now, and my mobile data mode is turned off, can you help me figure out what's going on?
